**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Add the required asyncio regression coverage**

The shared parser also serves `AsyncSearchCommands.aggregate`, but this regression constructs only the synchronous client. Root `AGENTS.md` explicitly requires testing both stacks, so add an async `fixed_client` counterpart using `redis.asyncio.Redis` and an `AsyncMock` response, asserting that the live row is preserved and the expired row becomes empty. The implementation is already shared; the missing piece is coverage through the async entry point.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L168-L168](https://github.com/redis/redis-py/blob/78df81a78686dc9648cbcfaa593cce915ab8053c/AGENTS.md#L168-L168)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Move the regression test imports to module scope**

Root `AGENTS.md` explicitly requires avoiding function-level imports unless absolutely necessary. Neither import needs deferred loading here: `unittest.mock` is part of the standard library, and this module already imports `redis.commands.search` at module scope. Move `patch` and `redis` into the existing top-level import block to comply with the repository's import convention.
